title: feat(platform-objects): add and remove an IdP group mapping from Setup
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9FtKWefJAsfBknskRbuBTi)_

Part of #32185 (item 2: the IdP group-mapping form in Setup)

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Setup → IdP Group Mappings 不再只读。`sys_idp_group_mapping` 声明了三个 `type: 'api'` 动作：列表工具栏的 **Map SSO Group** / **Map SCIM Group**（POST `set-group-mapping`），每行的 **Delete Mapping**（POST `delete-group-mapping`，`recordIdParam: mappingId` + 确认文案）。只对平台管理员显示，并声明 `manage_platform_settings` 门。plugin-auth 的 set 门在封闭键集里额外放行 `organizationId` 一个键（不读取它）。
- 为什么改：以前只能靠运维脚本直接 POST 这两个门来建、删映射；#32185 第 2 项要求在 Setup 里有表单。
- 风险与回滚：动作门本来就给 `/api/v1/auth/` 目标盖上 `organizationId`，封闭键集会拒掉它，所以 plugin-auth 改了一行（单独提交 55b59204）；映射仍落在源（SCIM 连接 / SSO 提供方）所在的组织，盖章值从不被读取，其它未知键照旧 400 `unknown_field`。数据 API 仍是 `['list']`，`lock: 'full'` 不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-idp-group-mapping.object.ts` 的 `actions` 块，`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/idp-group-mapping-admin.ts:100` 和 `:335`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run src/identity/sys-idp-group-mapping-actions.test.ts`（11 例通过），`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/scim-group-projection.test.ts -t "organizationId stamp"`（2 例通过）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。注意与 #32186 串行：它改同一个对象文件、11 个翻译包和 `scim-group-projection.test.ts`，谁后落谁合并 main 并重新生成翻译。

## Why the plugin-auth file rides here

The order assumed the door needed no change. Measured: every `type: 'api'` action aimed at an `/api/v1/auth/` path is posted with the caller's active organization stamped into the body as `organizationId`, on the server's action door (`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts:1604`) and on the console's direct path (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx:559`). `set-group-mapping` closes its body key set, so before this change every declared Map action was refused `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` (`organizationId: unknown_field`) for any admin with an active organization. The seat ruled the door admits exactly that key and reads nothing from it; the change is its own commit (55b59204) with its own pins.

## What changes

- **`sys_idp_group_mapping`** (`@objectstack/platform-objects`):
  - `map_sso_group`: params `providerId` (required), `groupExternalId`, `groupDisplayName`, `permissionSet` (required, `widget: 'permission-ref'`, the security-catalog picker). The door judges "exactly one of the two group keys" and answers with its own sentence.
  - `map_scim_group`: the same with `connectionId`. One action per source kind, so each sends exactly one of `connectionId` / `providerId`.
  - `delete_group_mapping`: `list_item` + `record_header`, `recordIdParam: 'mappingId'`, no params, a `confirmText` that says what the delete removes.
  - All three: `requiredPermissions: ['manage_platform_settings']` (PLATFORM_ADMIN_SETTINGS_GATE), `visible: current_user.isPlatformAdmin == true`, `refreshAfter`, no `ai` block (they postdate the ADR-0011 identity-actions assessment).
  - `listViews.all.emptyState`: the engine-owned bucket's fallback says rows "appear automatically", which stopped being true; the view now says how to add one.
  - `managedBy: 'engine-owned'` (the "System-managed" header badge) is unchanged: it also enrols the object in plugin-security's engine-owned write guard, so changing it is not safe here.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-auth`**: `set-group-mapping` admits `organizationId` (`ACTION_DOOR_STAMP_KEY`) and ignores it; route-ledger notes name the three actions.
- **Translations**: regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`; the new leaves translated in all ten non-English locales, then regenerated again so the source-hash companions settle. No generated structure edited by hand.
- **Changeset**: `.changeset/32185-idp-group-mapping-setup-actions.md` (both packages, patch).

## Tests

- `sys-idp-group-mapping-actions.test.ts` (new, 11): route, method, locations, param names and required set; every param is a key the save admits and each Map action names exactly one source; the picker widget; delete's `recordIdParam` + confirm; a live-instrument control; the declared gate; CEL visibility for a platform admin (true), an org admin and a member (false); no `ai.exposed`; lock / list-only API / engine-owned unchanged; the list's own empty state.
- `platform-admin-affordance-standing.test.ts`: the family floor names the three actions.
- `scim-group-projection.test.ts` (2 new): a body carrying `organizationId` naming another org lands in the source's organization; `organizationId` + `tenantId` is refused with only `tenantId: unknown_field` and nothing stored. (Inserted before the agent-ceiling block, not at the end, to stay clear of #32186's append.)
- `useConsoleActionRuntime.createUserRequiredField-28289.test.tsx` (5 new, console against a stub door): Map SSO Group posts to `/api/v1/actions/sys_idp_group_mapping/map_sso_group` and refreshes; a boundary `400` shows the door's sentence in the dialog, keeps the values, no refresh; a `409` conflict shows its first sentence and the "More" disclosure reveals the delete-first instruction; Delete asks the confirm sentence once and posts `mappingId`; a `404` delete surfaces the door's sentence.

### Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored, `git diff HEAD` empty after each)

| # | mutation | result |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | `delete_group_mapping`'s `requiredPermissions` → `[]` | red: 2 of 16 (`each declares the door's platform-settings gate…` here, and the affordance-standing floor's `each member declares its gate…`) |
| A2 | drop `&& key !== ACTION_DOOR_STAMP_KEY` in the door | red: both stamp cases (`organizationId is not a field of a group mapping…`, `expected 400 to be 200`) |

A1's first attempt was refused by the tool (replacement count 1→1, the replacement contained its anchor) and re-run with a marker replacement.

## Acceptance notes

- Browser, showcase dev boot, platform admin, SSO on (a SAML provider registered): add a mapping and see the row; pick `admin_full_access` and see the door's refusal sentence in the dialog; delete the mapping from the row menu with the confirm sentence and see the empty state. Screenshots in the os-dev report.
- The permission-set picker lists the whole catalog, administrator sets included; the door refuses those with its boundary sentence. Narrowing the picker would need a filtered data source the widget does not take today.
- A refusal shows twice in the dialog (the runner's toast and the dialog's refusal box); that is the shared action runtime, unchanged here.
- Serial with #32186 (still open at the time of writing): it edits `sys-idp-group-mapping.object.ts`, the eleven translation bundles and `scim-group-projection.test.ts`. Whichever lands second merges `main` and regenerates the translations.

## Verification

Head `52a8d5b8f9` (merge base `8523ef9ac` with `origin/main`; four upstream commits since, none on this surface). Every run below under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run`: 121 files, 1945 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run`: 255 files, 4589 passed, 10 skipped.
- `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useConsoleActionRuntime.createUserRequiredField-28289.test.tsx`: 11 passed.
- Type-check: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` `typecheck`, `@objectstack/platform-objects` `typecheck`, `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check`: all exit 0 (after a full `pnpm build`, exit 0).
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0; `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols` exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 74 families, every one run, every one exit 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 (shallow clone, fixture commit unreachable); fetched the pinned commit and re-ran: exit 0. `--ran`: 74 derived, 74 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Artifact-roster families whose roster sits under a directory this change touches, run as well: `check:authz-resolver`, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, plus `check:route-ledger-census` and `check:engine-double-contract`: all exit 0.
- Not run locally: CI's Test Core shards, dogfood jobs and workspace type-check lanes (outside the derived set). No dogfood battery: the title has no `!` and the Clause-② line carries the `(widening)` arm.
